name: Schoology
description_en:
Schoology is currently presented as PowerSchool Learning Management (Schoology), a K–12 LMS connecting classroom content, assignments, assessments and family communication. The legacy Schoology homepage returned no usable text; research therefore uses PowerSchool’s current official product page.

Schoology is one product within PowerSchool’s wider ecosystem. SIS, advanced assessment and professional-learning products are adjacent systems, not automatically included features of every Schoology deployment.
description_zh:
Schoology 当前以 PowerSchool Learning Management (Schoology) 呈现，是连接课堂内容、作业、考核及家庭沟通的 K–12 LMS。旧官网没有返回可用正文，因此采用 PowerSchool 当前官方产品页。

它属于 PowerSchool 产品生态，SIS、高级考核和专业学习产品是相邻系统，不能默认所有 Schoology 部署都包含。

sources.title: Learning Management | PowerSchool
sources.research_notes_en: Current PowerSchool official page explicitly names Learning Management (Schoology); read roles, OneRoster FAQ, mastery/grade passback and adjacent products. Legacy schoology.com yielded no text.

sources.title: Talk to an Expert | PowerSchool
sources.research_notes_en: Read official PowerSchool sales entry linked from Schoology page; no numeric rate or standard meter, separate support/login routes.

official_check.scope: Public official documentation research; no account, purchase, live workflow, performance, owner identity or publication approval verified.

review_notes: Original English research and corresponding Chinese translation by Codex AI; vendor documentation is not independent product testing.
Examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance. Chinese text does not establish a Chinese product interface.

sections.en: The current page explicitly names Learning Management (Schoology) and describes curriculum, assignments, assessments, communication, an Elementary Experience and standards-based mastery tracking. Its FAQ says PowerSchool SIS is not mandatory and describes OneRoster 1.2 integration with other SIS systems. This is a current vendor capability statement, not evidence that a particular district synchronization is already configured.
sections.zh: 当前页明确写 Learning Management (Schoology)，介绍课程、作业、考核、沟通、低年级体验及标准掌握跟踪。FAQ 明确不强制使用 PowerSchool SIS，并介绍通过 OneRoster 1.2 与其他 SIS 接入。这是当前厂商能力说明，不证明某学区同步已配置。

sections.title_en: Example: assignment feedback and guardian visibility
sections.title_zh: 示例：作业反馈与监护人可见信息
sections.en: Pilot one class and assignment with teacher, student and family accounts. Submit and grade a sample, then verify what each role sees and whether any SIS grade passback preserves the expected result. Test a changed grade, missing enrollment and an unrelated guardian relationship before scaling. The platform can organize these tasks, but the correct access and data mappings remain an implementation responsibility. No district data was accessed here.
sections.zh: 用教师、学生和家庭账户试点一个班级和作业。提交及评分样例，再确认各角色看到什么，以及 SIS 成绩回传是否保留预期结果。扩大前检查成绩更改、选课缺失及无关监护关系。平台可组织任务，但正确权限和数据映射仍属于实施责任。本文未访问学区数据。

sections.title_en: Contact PowerSchool for the institution’s scope
sections.en: The product page links to the official sales contact, which separates new sales from parent/student login help and existing-customer support. No numeric price, standard billing unit or continuing free plan is verified in the retrieved sales material. Request Schoology-specific learner count, term, onboarding, SIS connectors, AI entitlements and training. Do not treat the whole PowerSchool catalog as a bundled quote.
sections.zh: 产品页链接官方销售联系，区分新采购、家长学生登录帮助及现有客户支持。读取的销售资料未核实金额、标准计费单位或持续免费版。应询问 Schoology 具体人数、周期、上线服务、SIS 连接、AI 权益及培训，不能把整个 PowerSchool 目录当组合报价。

sections.en: The product FAQ describes PowerBuddy assistance and integrations with Performance Matters and Professional Learning; exact purchased rights need confirmation. Schoology fits institution-managed classroom workflows rather than a standalone course-selling business. Current source ownership is supported by PowerSchool explicitly naming Schoology, even though its registered domain differs from the legacy record. Deployment, source licensing, retention and restoration were not verified.
sections.zh: 产品 FAQ 介绍 PowerBuddy 辅助及 Performance Matters、Professional Learning 接入，实际购买权益仍需确认。它适合机构管理的课堂流程，而非独立课程销售业务。PowerSchool 官方明确命名 Schoology，支持本次来源归属，尽管注册域与旧档案不同。部署、源码许可、保留及恢复未核实。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
